results.fact: Route distance: dist_km 8.85 (~5.5 mi one way) vs itinerary 15 mi round trip
results.evidence: On this row, the approach and approach_variants put camp at about 6 mi (distMi 6.5), and the summit waypoint sits at distMi 7.5. The two itinerary days total 15 mi, so about 7.5 mi one way. One external account of the south approach gives 6 miles from the Beverly/Bean Creek trailhead to the Ingalls Creek camp. A 2024 party covered 16 miles round trip on the same Fourth Creek Pass approach to a point high on the peak. dist_km's 5.5 mi is shorter than the trailhead-to-camp leg alone, so it cannot be the one-way figure.

results.fact: Route name 'Southeast Ridge' vs prose describing the 'East Ridge' from the Argonaut-Colchuck col
results.evidence: This is a real conflation of two routes. Separate route pages exist for Argonaut's Southeast Ridge (II 5.6, 8 pitches, tops out on the southeast spire, two single or one double rappel into the notch) and its East Ridge. The ridge from the Argonaut-Colchuck col is the line the Northwest Arete party descends. The row's name, face, pitches and rappels describe the Southeast Ridge. Its beta, approach (to the col, a notch west of a lone gendarme, '6 pitches'), pitch_detail, descent_text and rappel_detail describe the col-side East Ridge, and rappel_detail's 'traverse a snow-covered ledge toward the east gully' comes from the Northeast Couloir descent. Fixing it means rewriting the beta, approach, breakdown and descent from a full Southeast Ridge description, which could not be fetched (403). Flagged, not patched.
